chunk.label: Initialize Flow

notes: repair_thought_process captured: Mapped ArkTS async Promise<void> to Cangjie Future<Unit> using spawn and .get() for synchronous waiting. Expanded default parameter forceNewAuthKey into two overloads to satisfy Cangjie syntax constraints. Used Option<T> semantics (None, isNone) for nullable authKey handling as per safety guidelines.
Assumed SessionInfo fields authKey and authKeyState are mutable properties accessible via this.session.
Assumed createAuthKey method exists in class scope and returns Future<AuthKeyResult>.
Used Option semantics for authKey null checks; if SessionInfo uses nullable types, None maps to null.
